content.text: MONTHLY REPORT OF STATE SALES AND USE TAX GROSS COLLECTIONS AND TAXABLE SALES

Data are compiled from reports and remittances made by taxpayers, and are classified according to sales and use tax registrations. Detail data from this report may not be directly comparable to that in reports for other months because of corrections in registrations affecting collections and taxable sales within the business and county classifications, and changes in the sales and use tax law. **NO** county sales and use taxes are included in this report.

items.text: Amounts shown are gross collections of sales and use tax (including collections of penalties and interest) processed by the Department of Revenue for the month of December 2023. Data reflect sales (including purchases for use) primarily for November 2023, but may include sales for prior periods.

content.text: Note: Data include sales and purchases for use of aircraft, boats, and manufactured and modular homes to the extent taxable; such transactions are exempt from county sales and use taxes.

— Sales not tabulated. Gross receipts derived from piped natural gas, electricity, telecommunications service and ancillary service, video programming service (direct-to-home satellite and other), spirituous liquor, aviation gasoline and jet fuel transactions are taxed at the combined general rate of 7%.
Gross receipts derived from the short-term lease or rental of a motor vehicle are taxed at the rate of 8%; those from vehicle subscriptions are taxed at the rate of 5%.
